setup.scope: This market covers the global sale of finished smartphone devices — handheld mobile computing/communication devices running a general-purpose mobile operating system (Android, iOS, HarmonyOS, KaiOS, etc.) with cellular voice/data connectivity — valued at the point of sale to end users (consumer and enterprise), including all price bands, form factors (bar, foldable/flip), and connectivity generations (4G/LTE, 5G). It excludes non-smart feature phones, tablets, laptops, wearables, and other connected devices, and excludes separately valued adjacent markets such as mobile operating systems/app stores, carrier connectivity plans, and aftermarket accessories or repair services. Component and semiconductor supply (chipsets, displays, memory, cameras) is not valued as part of this market, though component shipment data may be used as an intermediate signal to derive device volumes. Replacement/upgrade purchases are in scope as part of ongoing device replacement cycles; refurbished-device resale is out of scope as a separately valued market.

setup.scope: This market covers smartphones as complete, finished mobile communication devices that run a general-purpose mobile operating system and support third-party application installation and high-speed internet access, valued at the point of sale to end users (retail/consumer channel, including carrier and online sales). It explicitly EXCLUDES feature phones and other basic telephony-only handsets, and it excludes separately valued component and accessory markets such as smartphone camera lenses, PTZ camera modules, MEMS sensors, SoCs, chargers, and cases, as well as repair/refurbishment services and enterprise software. Component and accessory production volumes (e.g. camera-lens or SoC shipments) may still be used as intermediate evidence to derive how many finished smartphones are built and sold, but those components are never priced or valued as part of this market. Rugged/waterproof variants are included as smartphones, not as a separate market.
